definitions.explanation: In geometry, the portion of a line between two endpoints. Unlike a line, which extends infinitely in both directions, a line segment has a definite length.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line) and ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (part, segment). A fundamental geometry term taught in elementary and middle school mathematics. The concept distinguishes a bounded portion of a line (with two endpoints) from a full ⟦{直線|ちょくせん}→直線：05440_chokusen⟧ (line, extending infinitely) or a {半直線|はんちょくせん} (ray, extending infinitely in one direction).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {線分|せんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧: length of a line segment
- {線分|せんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中点|ちゅうてん}: midpoint of a line segment
- {線分|せんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a line segment
- {線分|せんぶん}AB⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二等分|にとうぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bisect line segment AB

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{直線|ちょくせん}→直線：05440_chokusen⟧: straight line — extends infinitely in both directions
- {半直線|はんちょくせん}: ray — has one endpoint, extends infinitely in one direction
- ⟦{辺|へん}→辺：00937_hen⟧: side (of a polygon) — a line segment forming part of a shape
